title: Error detection method and device
abstract: The invention provides an error detection method and device, and belongs to the technical field of quantum computing. In the quantum circuit for measuring the stabilizer generator, the stabilizer generator is divided into the X type and the Z type to detect errors respectively, the flag particles are added to detect the X error and the Z error introduced by the quantum gate in the quantum circuit, and the error detection function and the fault tolerance function are realized only by using four auxiliary particles. Therefore, the overhead of the auxiliary particles is greatly reduced. Besides, the stabilizer generators are divided into two types to be measured respectively, and quantum gates corresponding to the operators of the two types act on different auxiliary bits, so that propagation of errors on the coding block is reduced. In addition, the method is applied to general quantum stable sub-codes.

title: Quantum circuit diagram rendering method and device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention provides a quantum circuit diagram rendering method and device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of quantum gate circuits, quantum circuits, quantum circuit diagrams, visualization and image rendering. The method comprises the following steps: in response to a received display request of a target quantum circuit diagram, determining a visual area for presenting partial image content of the target quantum circuit diagram; on the basis of the minimum function units forming each quantum gate circuit diagram, determining to-be-rendered objects of a target quantum gate circuit falling into a visible area in the target quantum circuit diagram, and pre-cutting the multi-bit quantum gate circuit into the corresponding number of minimum unit function units according to the number of key bits and the number of connecting lines which are owned by the multi-bit quantum gate circuit, each minimum function unit is used as an object to be rendered; and rendering the to-be-rendered object, and presenting a rendering result. By applying the method, the number of rendering objects during local rendering can be minimum, the local rendering efficiency is improved, and the local rendering time consumption is reduced.

title: Wireless channel prediction method based on quantum computing
abstract: The invention discloses a wireless channel prediction method based on quantum computing. The method comprises: firstly, using the channel estimation algorithm to estimate the channel parameters basedon the relative position of the transmitting end and the receiving end, the speed of the receiving end, and other factors; dividing the channel parameter data into sample data and test data; then inputting the sample data into an extreme learning machine for training, and obtaining the training parameters of the extreme learning machine by solving the quantum linear equations; finally, testing thetraining parameters of the learning machine by using the test data, and optimizing the training parameters. The wireless channel prediction method based on quantum computing combines the classical algorithm with the quantum computing, and replaces the subroutine having higher complexity in solving the linear equations with the quantum computing, thereby effectively reducing the complexity of theclassical algorithm without affecting the performance of the algorithm.

title: Method for estimating the thermodynamic properties of a quantum Ising model with transverse field
abstract: A method for estimating a thermodynamic property of a quantum Ising model with transverse field is disclosed. The method comprises obtaining an indication of a thermodynamic property to approximate for the quantum Ising model with transverse field; obtaining data representative of the quantum Ising model with transverse field; setting the quantum Ising model with transverse field using the obtained data representative of the quantum Ising model with transverse field on a quantum Ising model sampling device, the quantum Ising model sampling device being operatively coupled to a processing device and to a quantum Ising model sampling device control system; performing a plurality of measurements of the quantum Ising model with transverse field in a measurement axis using the quantum Ising model sampling device, each measurement providing a corresponding measured configuration; generating an effective classical Ising model corresponding to the quantum Ising model with transverse field; generating a plurality of effective configurations of the effective classical Ising model, each effective configuration comprising a set of more than one of the measured configurations; generating an approximation of the thermodynamic property of the effective classical Ising model using the generated plurality of effective configurations of the effective classical Ising model to approximate the thermodynamic property of the quantum Ising model with transverse field; and providing the approximation of the thermodynamic property.

title: Bilinear interpolation-based GQIR quantum image zooming-in and zooming-out method
abstract: The invention discloses a bilinear interpolation-based GQIR quantum image zooming-in and zooming-out method, wherein an image of any size can be represented judging from the quantum storage manner and the scaling effect is superior to that of a nearest neighbor interpolation method judging from the interpolation method. The above method is applicable to many practical image processing application, such as quantum image watermarking and the like, wherein efficient quantum image scaling techniques are required. Meanwhile, the method has important significance on the perfection and the application of the quantum computing theory. The invention also discloses a design method for designing a GQIR quantum image zooming line based on bilinear interpolation, and a quantum circuit design diagram for implementing the same. The design diagram realizes the zooming line by adopting a basic quantum bit gate comprising a quantum bit controlled door and a single quantum bit gate.

title: Automatic quantum program optimization using adjoint-via-conjugation annotations
abstract: None of the existing quantum programming languages provide specialized support for programming patterns such as conditional-adjoint or adjoint-via-conjugation. As a result, compilers of these languages fail to exploit the optimization opportunities mentioned in this disclosure. Further, none of the available quantum programming languages provide support for automatic translation of circuits using clean qubits to circuits that use idle qubits. Thus, the resulting circuits oftentimes use more qubits than would be required. Embodiments of the disclosed technology, thus allow one to run said circuits on smaller quantum devices. Previous multiplication circuits make use of (expensive) controlled additions. Embodiments of the disclosed technology employ multipliers that work using conditional-adjoint additions, which are cheaper to implement on both near-term and large-scale quantum hardware. The savings lie between 1.5 and 2× in circuit depth for large number of qubits.

title: Method and device for editing quantum logic gate on terminal interface
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for editing a quantum logic gate on a terminal interface. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an addition operation of a user for the quantum logic gate on a terminal interface quantum circuit; responding to the adding operation, and displaying the added quantum logic gate on the quantum circuit; receiving an editing operation of a userfor the added quantum logic gate; and in response to the editing operation, visually displaying a preset display mode which changes along with the editing operation of the quantum logic gate on a terminal interface. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, when a user constructs and operates the quantum circuit, the user can conveniently add transpose conjugation of the quantum logic gate inthe quantum circuit and add corresponding control bit operation at the same time, so that visual display is achieved, the user experience is improved, and the blank of related technologies is filled.

title: Intermediate code generation method and device for quantum program compilation
abstract: The invention discloses an intermediate code generation method and device for quantum program compiling. The method comprises the steps of obtaining that a source code of a quantum program is obtained;, wherein the logic structure of the source code at least comprises a quantum branch structure, a quantum circulation structure and a quantum logic gate; carrying out lexical analysis on the source code, and segmenting the source code into a plurality of grammatical unit tokens; performing grammatical analysis on all tokens, and constructing an abstract syntax tree AST; wherein the AST comprisesa root node, a plurality of sub-tree nodes and a plurality of leaf nodes, the root node and the sub-tree nodes comprise grammar rule information, and the leaf nodes comprise token information; and according to the node information of the AST and a preset construction rule, constructing an intermediate code corresponding to the source code. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, repeated labor can be avoided, and resource occupation is reduced.

title: Text classification method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a text classification method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: converting a text corpus into a target quantum line according to the part-of-speech, meaning and relevance of each vocabulary in the text corpus; wherein the relevance comprises a relationship between each vocabulary and other vocabularies in the text corpus; the operation result of the target quantum circuit is obtained, and the operation result comprises the output result of the quantum bit when the target quantum circuit is operated every time; and obtaining a prediction classification result of the text corpus according to the operation result. Therefore, the quantum network technology is closely combined with text classification, and texts are accurately and quickly classified by using the target quantum line.

title: Data clustering method and device based on quantum computing and quantum computer
abstract: The invention discloses a data clustering method and device based on quantum computing and a quantum computer, and the method comprises the steps: preparing quantum states of to-be-clustered data, calculating the similarity between the quantum states, enabling the similarity to be used for representing the distance between the corresponding to-be-clustered data, and enabling the distance between the to-be-clustered data to be equal to the distance between the to-be-clustered data to be equal to the distance between the to-be-clustered data; the quantum states are subjected to cluster division according to the similarity, the to-be-clustered data with the similarity meeting a first preset condition are divided into the same cluster, and the cluster is a set of the to-be-clustered data. According to the embodiment of the invention, the quantum computing and the clustering algorithm can be combined, the parallel acceleration advantage of the quantum computing is exerted, and the calculation amount required for processing a traditional clustering task is reduced.

title: METHOD FOR CONTROLLING ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR AUTHENTICATING OUTPUT OF CLASSIFIER USING ORTHOGONAL INPUT ENCODING
abstract: Disclosed are an electronic device and a control method. The electronic device comprises an input interface and at least one processor. The at least one processor controls the input interface to receive input of data in bit format. The at least one processor converts bits of the inputted data into qubits. The at least one processor encodes the converted qubits. The at least one processor estimates a preset number of quantum amplitude values of the qubits using a quantum neural network (QNN) on the basis of the encoded qubits. The at least one processor identifies a probability value for the data on the basis of the estimated preset number of quantum amplitude values. The at least one processor authenticates the inputted data by comparing the identified probability value with a preset authentication radius value.

title: Randomized quantum algorithm for statistical phase estimation
abstract: A system and method for estimating values of an operator, such as energy levels of a Hamiltonian, is disclosed. The estimation is performed in a way such that the runtime of performing the estimation is independent of a complexity of the operator, e.g., a number of terms in the Hamiltonian. Also, errors can be statistically suppressed by performing additional sampling, due to a lack of biased error in the estimator. Additionally, samples may be tested using only a single ancilla qubit.

title: Quantum attention mechanism method based on quantum circuit
abstract: The invention provides a quantum attention mechanism method based on a quantum circuit, and belongs to the field of quantum computing. According to the quantum attention mechanism method based on the quantum lines, classic sequence data are encoded into a first quantum state, the first quantum state is input into three quantum lines respectively, three processing matrixes Q, K and V are output after three unitary transformation, the processing matrixes Q and K are evolved in a similarity line, and the quantum attention mechanism is obtained. title: A quantum line nearest neighbor two-dimensional grid form selection method
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum line nearest neighbor two-dimensional grid form selection method, which comprises the following specific steps of: setting the quantum digit of a quantum line as n, setting the row number and the column number of a grid as m1 and m2 respectively, and taking n as a fixed value; traversing all the values of m1 and m2 meeting the formula 1, i.e., n, m1 and m2 need tomeet the following relationship: the formula 1 is that n is greater than or equal to m1 * m2 and less than or equal to 2n, and | m1-m < 2 > is greater than or equal to n; M < 2 > | < = 1; In all m1 and m2, judging the number gn of the garbage quantum bits, i.e., gn = m1 * m2 <->; N, preferentially selecting a grid with the least number of junk quantum bits as a parameter of a next stage operationby using iterative search on the premise of meeting the formula 1; and taking the m1 value and the m2 value with the minimum garbage quantum bit number gn in the step C, and outputting the m1 value and the m2 value. According to the method, the grid form is determined by using the number of the junk quantum bits, so that the number of exchange gates and the required cost in the quantum line nearest neighbor process are effectively reduced, and meanwhile, the time cost of overall operation is also reduced.

title: Diamond NV color center fluorescence high-efficiency collection device
abstract: The invention provides a diamond NV color center fluorescence high-efficiency collection device, belongs to the field of diamond NV color center fluorescence detection, and is expected to be applied to various quantum detection devices such as a diamond NV color center-based quantum computer, a gravity gradiometer, an accelerometer, a thermometer and a single-photon imager. title: Toom 3-Way DEVICE AND METHOD OF QUANTUM CIRCUIT DESIGN FOR TOOM 3-WAY MULTIPLICATION
abstract: Disclosed are a device and a method of designing a quantum circuit for toom 3-way multiplication, capable of optimizing a naive multiplication manner employing a fully repeated addition operation. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a device of designing a quantum circuit for toom 3-way multiplication includes: a split block; an operating block; a multiplication block; and an interpolation block. The split block splits each input (x, y) into three parts to create three segments for the x value and three segments for the y value. The operating block acquires five operation values by performing an operation with respect to the three segments for the x value along five specific points and acquires five operation values by performing an operation with respect to three segments for the y value, such that the total 10 operation values are acquired. The multiplication block derives a multiplication value by performing point multiplication among the total 10 operation values. The interpolation value outputs a verification value as a multiplication result for each input (x, y) by interpolating the multiplication value.
